thread:
jas: Hey folks, new hire here. My company MBP arrived but Kandji never enrolled and FileVault didn't prompt. Trying to install brew gives permission denied. Anyone know the usual fix?

marta-it: welcome! can you run `profiles status` and `system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep Serial` then paste outputs? also confirm you completed Okta sign-in during setup.

jas: okta done. serial: C02XK0P8L2MN
profiles status: No enrolled MDM profile found.

it-bot: Ticket CREATED-4121 opened and assigned to marta-it.

marta-it: looks like the device wasn't assigned to the new Kandji server after our ABM migration. i'll assign it manually. meanwhile if you need sudo, file the devex one-time admin form: https://internal.redwood/devex/admin-request

devex-ryan: i can approve a 2-hour grant if needed. post the request id after you submit.

jas: submitted request ADM-8012

marta-it: done from my side, pushed enrollment. reboot and run `profiles status`.

jas: after reboot shows "MDM: Kandji (managed)" and FileVault prompt appeared. brew installs fine. thanks!

marta-it: closing the ticket, and adding a KB note about ABM reassigns for new hires.

devex-ryan: revoked ADM-8012 early since it wasn't needed. welcome aboard!
